risks: The proportion case appears under both success-1 and success-11, because both lines state the rule; `gov accept` counts it under each. Parametrised ids are matched exactly, so renaming a parameter later silently drops its case from its line. A renamed id is still named in the table but matches nothing, so its line then fails rather than passing.
lessons: Parse a README with `gov.accept.runner.parse_map` before running `gov accept`. A table row whose KPI cell starts with a line name followed by "(…)" reads cleanly. Don't put "and" right after the line name (the reader treats "and" as a joiner and looks for a second line name).
